title: Myth of the Sun's Eye (P. Leiden I 384) with Greek version (P. Lond. Lit. 192) / «Миф о Солнечном Оке»
author: Anonymous
date: Demotic manuscript 2nd c. CE; Greek version 3rd c. CE
edition: Spiegelberg, Der ägyptische Mythus vom Sonnenauge (1917; public domain, archive.org); de Cenival 1988 (French).
ru_evidence: Only three inserted fables, in a popular version: И.С. Кацнельсон, «Фараон Хуфу и чародеи» (1958), contents checked on archive.org.
en_evidence: de.wikipedia lists only German and French editions; no complete English translation found.
value: A rare Egyptian–Greek bilingual literary work containing Aesopic fables (Lion and Mouse). Central to Greco-Egyptian literary exchange and fable studies.
ai_feasibility: low-medium: the Demotic is hard, helped by Spiegelberg's public-domain transcription and German. The Greek version is easy.
pilot_unit: Greek version + corresponding Demotic columns (est. 3–5 columns)
